grammar.summary: 本课学习时间表达与 would 表过去将来。

points.title: would 表过去将来/意愿
points.explanation: would + 动词原形，过去视角的将来或委婉意愿：We would like to go home. 本课 crowd 场景描写中 would 表意愿。

examples.en: The big clock refused to welcome the New Year.

points.title: 时间刻度表达
points.explanation: at two minutes past twelve（12点02分）；minutes past/to 的前后界定：小于30分用 past，大于30分用 to。

examples.en: At two minutes past twelve, the clock stopped.
